core.title: Heart Hand Forged Hook, Acorn AMABP

text.description_html:
Acorn AMABP, Hand Forged Split Heart Hook

This Hand Forged Split Heart Hook is a small, yet beautiful reminder of the old world. Perfect for almost any home, it is handy for keeping things off the floor in almost any room. Screw a few in by the front door for keys and lightweight bags or hang one in the kitchen for hand towels. It is made out of iron with a smooth, matte black finish.

Features and Specifications of the Heart Hand Forged Hooks:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 3-3/4"

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 hook and mounting screw.
